crossRefs.note: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed…
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;
Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and…
Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom…
Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and…
All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and…

translations.web: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
translations.bsb: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
translations.kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
translations.asv: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
